entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have an order and I think I need to return something. The website was a bit overwhelming, I wasn't sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Oh, um, preference, I guess. I bought a jersey, but it's the wrong size. It's just... far too tight across the chest. I was hoping I could exchange it, but I couldn't find the right page. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help sort this out for you. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF789012.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see the order. This is for the Aero Pro Jersey, delivered about 60 days ago. Is that correct?
60 days? Wow, yes, I suppose that's right. I was worried I had waited too long. Is it too late?
Not at all. Since this jersey is a standard apparel item, it falls under our 10-day return policy. You're unfortunately outside the window for a return or an exchange.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so confused by everything online.

I understand. I'm happy to confirm we can definitely process that exchange for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label and the instructions to the email we have on file. Once we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the new size you requested.
You've made this so simple. Thank you so much, Alex!
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
